finding: CF-A-GENERIC-LADDER-IS-NOT-A-CHECKLIST (Drew, 2026-09-12 widget ruling). backend/data/checklists/hand-fetched/parallels-2026-bowman-chrome-baseball.json (source baseballcardpedia+observed-sold-comps) was applied mechanically to every CPA-* card number under bowman-chrome, minting card_catalog rows (source 'checklist') for numbers that exist ONLY in the 2026 BOWMAN (paper) product's own checklist -- e.g. CPA-VF Victor Figueroa has 7 such rows here (gold-ink-variation, orange-x-fractor, superfractor, mini-diamond-refractor, bowman-logofractor, packfractor, black-white-shimmer). Doctrine: checklist is the authority; no synthetic parallels -- every row traces to a scraped source; Bowman vs Bowman Chrome are DIFFERENT cards (project_bowman_setkey_taxonomy); one card one row one pool; never mint from sales; absent beats wrong.
rulings: Authority sets built from disk: backend/data/checklists/scraped/2026-bowman-chrome.csv (100 CPA-* numbers) and 2026-bowman-full.csv (87 CPA-* numbers). 8 numbers -- CPA-AG, BC, DF, EM, HL, JS, LA, WA -- appear in BOTH files for DIFFERENT people (confirmed by comparing player names per number) and are legitimate distinct cards in both products; NONE of the 26 entries below touches any of those 8 numbers.

CPA-MG is excluded from this list entirely -- its catalog fold already ran 2026-09-05 (PR #2060, merged) and its pool relocation is a separate, already-drafted list (data/pool-relocations/2026-09-12-cpa-mg-bowman-chrome-to-bowman.json). This list does not duplicate or conflict with that lane.

CPA-VF's two Red Ink rows (hiq:baseball:2026:bowman-chrome:cpa-vf:black-white-red-ink:auto, the checklist-backed row, and its already-retired self-derived twin ...black-white-red-ink-refractor:auto) are OUT OF SCOPE for this list -- owned by the 08-30 Red Ink ruling and its 2026-09-12 twin-fold PR (data/pool-relocations/2026-09-12-figueroa-red-ink-twin-fold.json + data/catalog-relocations/2026-09-12-figueroa-red-ink-twin-retire.json), verified merged. Neither is an entry here.

5 of the 26 rows (cpa-vf:orange-x-fractor, cpa-vf:superfractor, cpa-ba:superfractor, cpa-ba:orange-x-fractor, cpa-eha:superfractor) have a checklist-backed Bowman equivalent at the same number+parallel+auto-flag (sources beckett-checklist / hobbymonitor-scraped-2026-08-31) and carry ZERO sold_comps sales on either address, so they retire outright with no pool-side relocate required.

21 of the 26 rows have NO Bowman equivalent in card_catalog. This is a CHECKLIST GAP, not a data error to route around: the acquired 2026 Bowman checklist's 'Chrome Prospect Autographs' section (87 base cards) carries no parallel column at all (manifest: parallelColumnAuthoritative with zero non-blank parallel values for that section), so a colour/serial parallel naming a CPA base-auto number has no Bowman address to fold onto -- only the separate Gold Ink (47 cards) and PackFractor (39 cards) sections have their own numbering, and even those do not cover every CPA number's PackFractor variant (see cpa-eha:packfractor below). Flagged for the acquisition queue (2026 Bowman CPA parallel ladder) rather than inventing rows.

Exactly ONE of the 26 rows (cpa-eha:packfractor:auto:num-89) carries a live sold_comps sale, counted on both addresses (cardId partition read + hobbyiqCardId filtered query, 1 on each, same row). It is PARKed by the paired pool list before this entry retires the row -- never mint from a sale, never repoint to an unattested address.
The other 25 rows carry zero sold_comps rows on either address (measured 2026-09-12) and need no pool-side action.
